claude_proposed_widenings.name: build_time_exclusive_choice
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Divine Order presents a permanent, build-time exclusive-OR between two entirely different passive grant bundles (Protector vs Thaumaturge). No existing ClassFeatureMechanics family supports this: PassiveMechanics has a flat grants list (all apply), CompositeClassFeatureMechanics combines parts that all apply simultaneously, and ProficiencyGrant.choice only selects among proficiency subjects, not among whole feature packages. A new mechanism is needed — either a top-level 'suborder_choice' family for ClassFeatureMechanics or a 'build_time_or' wrapper that permanently selects one of several passive grant bundles at character creation.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You have dedicated yourself to one of the following sacred roles of your choice. Protector. [...] Thaumaturge. [...]

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access open-list cantrip choice
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Thaumaturge grants 'one extra cantrip from the Cleric spell list' — the cantrip is player-chosen from an open category, not a single fixed spellId. grant_spell_access.spellId is a string literal requiring a specific known ID. A new variant is needed to express an open-list spell-class grant (analogous to ProficiencyGrant.choice but for spells).
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You know one extra cantrip from the Cleric spell list.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ability_modifier DiceDelta minimum constraint
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Thaumaturge bonus is '+Wisdom modifier, minimum of +1'. The ability_modifier DiceDelta kind carries no minimum field, so the floor cannot be expressed. A minimum?: number optional field on the ability_modifier variant would cover this and similar patterns.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The bonus equals your Wisdom modifier (minimum of +1).
